fields.statement: QA by hand with a fresh build at 009d74d2c (go build -trimpath to $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa) in a scratch root: rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.maxRuns auto exits 0 and daemon settings shows 'auto (rhiza.toml, machine)'; 0, -1, autox, AUTO, 1.5 and empty are refused exit 2 with 'must be a whole number of at least 1 or auto'; rhiza.project.maxRuns auto is refused ('must be a whole number of at least 1'); a hand-edited rhiza.toml with autox makes daemon settings fail naming the same rule; the daemon app's run-limit field (not drivable by pty) passes go test ./internal/tui/daemonapp/... (TestAutoLimitSetsAndQuits, TestLimitValidators) and go test ./internal/api -run MaxRuns passes.

QA by hand with the built binary, three accepted change sets, fake rex and RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG: under auto the first daemon --once started exactly one run (state max_runs 1, max_runs_auto true); with one run journaled the next poll started one more (max_runs 2); with two running, each of load high (RHIZA_TEST_LOAD1/5=3.5), memory low (MEM_AVAILABLE=1000), tmp low (TMP_FREE_BYTES=1000) and disk low (FREE_BYTES=1000) started none with the cap held at 2; maxRuns 2 pinned started none and dropped max_runs_auto; auto with --max-runs 2 pinned 2 (no auto); room again started the third (max_runs 3). TestScripts/daemon-maxruns-auto passes.

QA by hand holding the root daemon lock with flock over a saved state of 2 live runs and 1 starting: max_runs 1 with max_runs_auto true gives daemon status 'Max runs: auto (1 this poll)' and 'runs: 2 live (auto cap 1), 1 starting', --json max_runs_auto true, and health 'ok daemon' with 'runs: 2 live (auto cap 1), 1 starting'; the same state without auto gives 'Max runs: 1', health bad 'over rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 1' naming each live run, and --json has no max_runs_auto; a state with no field and max_runs 3 prints 'Max runs: 3', 'runs: 2/3 live'. TestScripts daemon-status, health-runs-cap, describe-golden pass.
